name: How do I know if my ceiling just needs paint or if it needs repairs first?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my ceiling just needs paint or if it needs repairs first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way to know what your ceiling needs is to look for **stains, water marks, peeling, cracks, or uneven sheen**. If the ceiling has smoke damage, moisture damage, or heavy discoloration, the surface usually needs cleaning, repairs, and primer before paint goes on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for stains, peeling, cracks, or water marks. If those are present, the ceiling likely needs prep or repairs before painting.
